title: Laser Technician
description:
Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry - we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

YOUR ROLE

Focused Energy is building a Focused Energy Lasers Austin (FELA) facility in Austin, TX, and this role exists to make that build happen at the bench level. As a Laser Technician, you'll own the hands-on execution of core laser experiments, such as setting up a laser front end, achieving two-dimensional SSD (smoothing by spectral dispersion), frequency tripling, FM-AM, and large-scale solid-state amplifier characterization experiments. You'll create the execution capacity FELA needs to move from facility build-out to a productive experimental program.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the hands-on setup, alignment, and execution of assigned FELA laser experiments including setting up the laser front end, running two-dimensional SSD, frequency tripling, FM-AM, and main amplifier characterization experiments.

- Lead bench-level troubleshooting.

- Drive the day-to-day experimental schedule, ensuring setups are ready and experiments run on time against the FELA build-out plan.

- Ensure all laser safety protocols and lab safety standards are followed without exception in a Class 3B/4 laser environment.

- Build and maintain organized, well-documented lab records covering equipment status, alignment logs, and experimental data.

- Improve experimental setups and procedures over time, identifying and proposing refinements based on hands-on experience.

- Partner with laser scientists on joint experimental sessions, providing reliable bench execution that enables scientific progress.

- Help the FELA facility scale its experimental program by building repeatable, well-documented setups that others can follow.

WHO YOU ARE

- Hands-on experience with fiber and free-space laser systems, nonlinear optics (frequency conversion, beam smoothing), laser beam characterization, and optical alignment and diagnostics.

- Comfortable working independently on bench-level setup, alignment, and troubleshooting, and know when to escalate a genuinely stuck problem rather than push through it.

- A systematic, methodical approach to experimental work, with strong lab notebook and data documentation habits.

- Working knowledge of laser safety standards (ANSI Z136) and experience operating safely in Class 3B/4 laser environments.

- Clear, proactive communicator - you flag issues early and keep your team members informed on progress and blockers.

- Take ownership of your work end-to-end and set a high bar for safety discipline and lab practice as the team grows around you.

- Preferred: Familiarity with laser modeling software (e.g. Miro, Zemax) and CAD tools (e.g. Inventor)

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

- Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you'll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

- Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

- Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

title: Hydrus - Voice Contributor - Spanish (Colombia)
description:
Description
About the Project
We're looking for native-level Spanish (Colombia) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project.
The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio.
Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment. 
What You'll Do
Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up
Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each
Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios
Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions
Your Recording Environment
Three things are required, and each is judged separately:
An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required - see below.
A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail. 
A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording.
Minimum Required Gear
Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar.
Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar.
Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples - isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc… 
Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets.
Technical Specification
You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications:
WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply - this level of technicality is required for this role.
Who We're Looking For
Native-level Spanish (Colombia) speaker
A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style
A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above
Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc - anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio
Commitment & Compensation
Estimated time: approximately 8 hours total across two scheduled sessions
Compensation: $35.00 USD per hour

Along the way, you’ll develop an understanding of how customers use Baseten and with this, define how our systems and product can improve.

title: Office Administrator
description:

Als Office Administrator zorg je ervoor dat onze Belgische organisatie administratief soepel draait. Je ondersteunt zowel de dagelijkse bedrijfsvoering als HR-processen en bent verantwoordelijk voor het bewaken van procedures, documentatie en compliance. Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je schakelt tussen administratie, HR, veiligheid, communicatie en algemene ondersteuning van het management.

Office Management

• Verwerken van inkomende correspondentie en e-mails.

• Beheren van documenten, contracten en bedrijfsadministratie.

• Ondersteunen bij offertes, facturatie en algemene administratie.

• Bijhouden van bedrijfsdocumentatie en archieven.

• Organiseren van afspraken en administratieve ondersteuning van het management.

• Bijhouden van verlof, afwezigheid en personeelsgegevens.

• Ondersteunen bij werving en selectie.

Policies & Compliance

• Opstellen en beheren van bedrijfsbeleid (Policies).

• Bijhouden van personeelshandboeken.

• Bijhouden van risicoanalyses en veiligheidsdocumentatie.

• Plannen van trainingen, toolbox meetings en certificeringen.

• Contact onderhouden met externe preventiediensten indien nodig.

Algemene ondersteuning

• Contact onderhouden met leveranciers en externe partijen.

• Ondersteunen van de Belgische directie.

• Meedenken over verbeteringen van processen.

• Signaleren van administratieve verbeterpunten.

Wie zoeken wij?
Je bent een zelfstandige, nauwkeurige en betrouwbare administratieve professional die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt.
Votre profil
Vous êtes une personne autonome, rigoureuse, fiable et organisée, qui apprécie prendre des responsabilités et qui sait travailler de manière indépendante.
Nous recherchons une personne qui possède :

• Un niveau Bachelier ou une expérience/formation équivalente.

• Minimum 3 ans d’expérience dans une fonction administrative, RH ou similaire.

• Une excellente maîtrise du français et du néerlandais.

• Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais.

• Une bonne connaissance de Microsoft Office 365.

• Une expérience avec des systèmes RH tels que BambooHR, Geodynamics et Officiënt constitue un atout, mais n’est pas indispensable.

• De solides compétences organisationnelles et administratives.

• Une grande discrétion dans la gestion d’informations confidentielles.

• La capacité à travailler de manière autonome, notamment en télétravail.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
The role
You are a Customer Success Specialist who makes sure our customers get real value out of the FrankieOne platform. You own a portfolio of live accounts and you are their day to day point of contact for anything product, adoption or operational.
Reporting to the Head of Customer Success, you sit in our offshore CS team managing our portfolio customers. This is the volume end of our book, and it is where the biggest opportunity sits. Today that engagement is largely reactive and driven by tickets. Your job is to help shift it toward something proactive: knowing which accounts are healthy, which ones are drifting, and getting ahead of problems before the customer raises them.
Implementations own technical onboarding, so your focus is what happens after going live. You track usage, work pass rates, resolve and escalate issues alongside Technical Support, run training and product education, and keep the customer moving forward. Where you spot a genuine expansion signal, you qualify it and hand it to the Account Manager to run commercially.
This is a technical space and it moves quickly. You will need to build real product depth to be credible with your customers, and we expect you to be up and running fast.
Your ticket to success:

• Be an advocate. For Frankie, for the product, for our people and for our values.

• Energy. You enjoy a high energy, high velocity environment. You enjoy a challenge and relish the opportunity to create something you can be proud of.

• Customer centricity. Your focus is the customer. You work with them to lift adoption, improve pass rates, and resolve issues quickly. You run training, product walkthroughs and configuration conversations, and you understand the metrics that matter to their business.

• Portfolio management. You manage a portfolio of accounts through data, not gut feel. You use health signals across tickets, usage and product adoption to work out where to spend your time, and you keep retention high across the book.

• Technical depth. You build a strong working knowledge of the FrankieOne platform: KYC, KYB, AML, fraud, cascades and OneSDK. You can read verification data, diagnose why a check failed, and explain it clearly to a customer.

• Collaboration. You work closely with Technical Support on issue resolution, with Implementations on handover into business as usual, and with Product on feedback that shapes the roadmap. You surface and qualify expansion signals and hand them to Account Management.

• Mentor. You train and coach junior members of the team, peer review their work, and share what you know.

In a previous life you have:

• 3+ years in a customer success, onboarding, implementation or product specialist role in B2B SaaS. Fintech, regtech or a compliance adjacent business is a strong advantage.

• Managed a portfolio of accounts and been accountable for retention across it.

• Worked in a technical product and built genuine depth in it, not just surface familiarity.

• Handled escalations and worked alongside technical teams to resolve them.

• Used data to prioritise your own work and to have better conversations with customers.

• Strong people skills, with a natural and collaborative presentation style.

• The ability to build rapport with anyone.

title: Mechanical Engineer, Senior
description:
Location: Onsite - Austin, TX

Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time

Job Title: Senior Mechanical Engineer

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge-on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

Why 9 Mothers?

While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month-not next year-this is your playground.

Position Summary

We are hiring a Senior Mechanical Engineer who specializes in mechanisms. Everything we build is a machine that has to move fast, hit hard, and keep working: belt-fed and high capacity shotgun actions, feed systems, gimbals, drive trains, and the gearboxes and linkages that tie them together. This role exists because the hardest problems we have are problems of motion, and we need one more person whose talent is seeing how parts move and interact before the parts exist.

This is not a product-owner role and it is not tied to one product. You will go wherever the hardest mechanical problem in the building is that month: a feed path that hangs up under one particular loading, a gear train that is louder than it should be, a latch that has to work at temperature after ten thousand cycles. You will work alongside our existing mechanical engineering team and you will be the person the team brings the ugly kinematics to.

The person we want has a well developed intuition for the ways objects can be made to move, and an equally well developed intuition for the ways objects object to being moved: friction, backlash, inertia, compliance, wear, thermal growth, contamination, and the tolerances that are fine on paper and not fine on a Tuesday afternoon in the dirt. We want clever solutions to complex mechanical problems, and we want the life experience to know when a clever solution is a bad idea. We want the person who hears that something is not quite right in a gearbox before anyone else in the room knows anything is wrong.

This is a hands-on role. You will build your own prototypes, run them on the bench and at the range, take them apart when they break, and figure out why. If your idea of a good weekend involves tearing down and rebuilding a machine to understand it, you will fit in here.

Essential Duties

- Solve the hard mechanism problems. Take on the feed, action, drive, latching, and timing problems that are blocking a product, from first sketch through working hardware. Own the concept, the kinematic and dynamic analysis, the detailed design, and the test.

- Design for motion under load. Cams, linkages, gear trains, springs, ratchets, escapements, detents, and the interfaces between them. Get the forces, timing, and energy budgets right, and make the mechanism tolerant of the real-world conditions it will see.

- Prototype with your own hands. Machine, print, fit, and assemble your own test articles. Instrument them. Cycle them until they break, then explain exactly why.

- Diagnose by ear, by hand, and by data. Find the root cause of a jam, a stall, a noise, a wear pattern, or an intermittent failure, and separate what the hardware is telling you from what the drawing says it should be doing. Partner with our test engineer on high-speed video and instrumented testing when the failure is too fast to see.

- Kill bad ideas early. Bring the judgment to recognize when a concept will not survive contact with tolerances, contamination, temperature,

title: Head of Sales @Verso (backed by Hexa)
description:
Paris-based (open to Europe for the right profile) | Full-time | Early team

Founded in 2025 by Lydia Bellahouel (CEO) and Camille Epitalon (CTO), Verso is backed by Hexa http://hexa.cc/ (eFounders), the pioneer European startup studio behind 40+ companies including Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

Consumer research has been slow and expensive for decades. We are building the company that changes that, and we need our first commercial hire: the person who brings our product to enterprise customers, closes our first flagship accounts, and helps define how Verso sells.

ABOUT VERSO AND WHO WE ARE

Verso is an AI-native consumer research platform. Our AI designs the study, interviews real participants one to one over video in any language, and turns those conversations into a structured, evidence-backed report you can interrogate in chat. Days instead of weeks, at a fraction of the cost of a traditional agency, without trading rigor for speed.

We sell to insights, marketing and innovation teams at global brands, with a strong pull from large CPG, beauty, telecom, retail, and the strategy consultancies that serve them. Early clients include Orange, Michelin, Europcar and dsm-firmenich. We are a small team with high standards and one clear thesis: qualitative research is high-signal and badly broken, and AI is finally good enough to fix it.

We start with AI-moderated qualitative research and are building for each client a system of consumer intelligence: every study compounds into a living understanding of their consumers that their teams, and their own AI, can draw on over time.

Lydia spent 7 years at BCG leading AI-powered transformation for consumer brands and knows the buyer's pain from the inside. Camille is an AI expert and a pioneer in agentic systems. Together they built Verso to turn consumer understanding into a real-time advantage for the brands we serve.

THE ROLE

We are hiring our Head of Sales, the first dedicated commercial hire at Verso.

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role, and you work hand in hand with the founders, Lydia in particular, who leads commercial today. You prospect, run demos, scope pilots, and close enterprise contracts yourself. As we grow, you help define how Verso sells and have the opportunity to build and lead the commercial team.

To be clear on the shape of it: you close deals now, and you grow into running the function next. This is not a co-founder seat, it is the first commercial hire, with real room to make the role your own. If you want the leadership part without the selling part, this is not it.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- From first meeting to signes customer. You work closely with our Founding GTM, who builds demand across outbound, inbound and events. You generate pipeline together, while also leveraging your own network and converting inbound opportunities into customers.

- The sales process itself. You turn founder-led selling into something repeatable: the motion, the collateral, the CRM discipline, the qualification bar, the pricing conversation. You decide what good looks like and write it down so the next hire can run it.

- Enterprise relationships. Our buyers are Heads of Insights and research leaders who buy on trust, not on a feature list. You build that trust, turn a first pilot into an annual program, and grow accounts study by study.

- AI-driven selling. You use AI across your own workflow, from research and prospecting to follow-ups and proposals, and you sell a product that is itself AI-native. You are fluent enough to demo it credibly and to make the "rigor, not hype" case to a skeptical researcher.

- Voice of the customer. You are closest to the market and bring structured feedback to the founders, helping shape what we build next.

WHO YOU ARE

- You have 5+ years of experience in enterprise B2B sales and have personally closed complex, consultative deals. You know how to navigate long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles and turn initial projects into long-term customer

Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? WHY SYSTEMS AT AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

WHY CAN THIS POSITION BE EXCITING FOR YOU?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

- Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

- Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

- Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

- Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

- Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on,

title: Social Media Designer — Data Analysis & Visual Storytelling
description:
Summary
Qwoted connects journalists with the experts, brands, and small businesses who can actually help them tell a story. We're the matchmaker between "I need a source by 3pm" and "I have exactly the person you need." Along the way, we end up sitting on a genuinely interesting pile of data about how PR and journalism actually work day to day, and we want someone who can turn that into stories worth sharing.
We need a data-savvy storyteller to look at real patterns in how journalists request sources and how PR pros pitch them, then turn what you find into visuals and short write-ups that work on social and have a real shot at getting picked up by media outlets. You will use Qwoted 's internal network data and industry data to find these patterns and statistics that would be interesting to media and PR audiences.
This role is about creating data-related content fordisplay on social channels. If you have the skill to work with raw data and you love to turn data into compelling visuals that create scroll-stopping experiences on social channels, this may be for you!
What you'll do

• Create compelling content for social media channels

• Analyze Qwoted 's platform data (pitch activity, source requests, response rates, demographic patterns, beat trends, etc.) to find angles worth telling

• Build clean charts and graphics that are social media ready

• Write short, punchy captions and summaries that explain the "so what" in plain English, built for social feeds first

• Package findings with enough supporting data and context that a journalist could plausibly write a full story off of it (stats, methodology notes, a quote-ready line or two, sources)

• Suggest new angles as you spend time in the data. We don't want someone who just executes a list, we want someone who spots things we haven't asked about yet

What you bring

• A knack for finding the interesting thread in a boring dataset

• Experience creating data visualization to get earned media pickup, not just internal reporting

• A sense of how to translate graphs and data for social carousels (or videos) on social platforms

• Ability to create interactive visuals

• Newsroom or journalism background is a bonus

• East Coast hours or general US-based availability preferred for overlap with our team

Technical Skills

• Working knowledge of data analysis tools (SQL, R, Python) and visualization platforms (Observable, Flourish, etc.)

• Experience with design and motion graphics tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects; also Canva or Affinity), plus data visualization/mapping tools (Mapcreator, Flourish, Infogram, Esri, Observable)

• Familiarity with front-end frameworks/libraries such as Svelte, D3.js, and Three.js for building and organizing interactive projects

• Experience with cloud hosting and deployment tools (e.g., Google Cloud, Fastly) for publishing work

title: Electrical Engineer (SCADA)
description:
Overview
SCADA Engineer
Location: Remote, Canada
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Travel: Up to 20% within Canada and the United States
Department: Engineering/Control Systems Integration
About Shermco Canada
Shermco Canada is a leading provider of electrical testing, maintenance, commissioning, engineering, and control systems integration services. Our teams support critical power systems and industrial infrastructure across Canada, helping customers improve safety, reliability, and operational performance.
We are committed to an industry-leading safety culture, technical excellence, employee development, and providing meaningful career opportunities for our people. Shermco Canada’s services include field services, power systems engineering, control systems integration, disaster recovery, locating services, and electrical equipment repair.
About the Opportunity
Shermco Canada is seeking an experienced SCADA Engineer to design, program, integrate, commission, and support SCADA and industrial automation systems.
This is a remote position open to qualified candidates residing in an approved location within Canada. The successful candidate will collaborate with customers, engineering teams, field personnel, contractors, and vendors to deliver reliable automation solutions for electrical power and industrial infrastructure projects.
Responsibilities

• Design, program, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot SCADA systems, PLCs, HMIs, RTUs, gateways, instrumentation, edge devices, and industrial networks.

• Configure and support Ignition SCADA applications, including Perspective HMI, scripting, alarming, Tag Historian, reporting, and data visualization.

• Develop SCADA specifications, network drawings, I/O lists, control narratives, commissioning records, and operational handover documentation.

• Lead or support Factory Acceptance Testing, Site Acceptance Testing, systems integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and operational handover.

• Review electrical drawings, P&IDs, control schematics, network diagrams, communication architectures, and panel designs.

• Coordinate with customers, internal teams, contractors, and vendors to meet technical requirements and project schedules.

• Identify opportunities to improve SCADA standards, cybersecurity, system performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

• Complete work in accordance with applicable safety, electrical, regulatory, customer, and Shermco requirements.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Automation, or a related engineering discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered.

• Five or more years of experience in SCADA design, programming, systems integration, commissioning, or troubleshooting.

• Experience with Ignition SCADA, including Perspective HMI, Python or Jython scripting, alarming, Tag Historian, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience configuring, programming, and troubleshooting PLCs, RTUs, industrial controllers, gateways, and edge devices.

• Knowledge of industrial networks, fibre optics, VPNs, remote access, OT communications, and protocols such as OPC UA, DNP3, Modbus TCP/RTU, and RS-485.

• Ability to interpret electrical single-line diagrams, P&IDs, control schematics, network diagrams, and I/O lists.

• Strong technical documentation, communication, problem-solving, and project coordination skills.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating with geographically dispersed teams.

• Legally entitled to work in Canada and able to travel within Canada and the United States, subject to applicable border-entry requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with electrical substations, protection and control systems, three-phase power, or power system automation.

• Experience with SEL protection relays, RTACs, AcSELerator software, Ignition Edge, Opto 22, CODESYS, or Red Lion products.

• Knowledge of solar power, battery energy

The CC Factory, within Nubank’s Credit Card Business Unit, is responsible for internationalizing our credit card product and creating a reusable foundation for launching it in new markets. The team recently launched credit card capabilities in the United States and is building the frameworks, platforms and AI-enabled practices required to scale into future countries.

As a Staff Software Engineer, AI & Credit Card Platform, you will operate across multiple squads and technical domains, helping shape how credit card products adapt to new markets. This is a strongly cross-functional role involving Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Compliance and platform partners.

You will combine deep technical leadership with hands-on execution: building reusable country-launch capabilities, driving AI transformation across the engineering lifecycle, and guiding architecture across three to four squads. This is a Staff-level role with potential to grow toward broader technical scope over time

- Building the Country Launch Engine: Create reusable systems that reduce the time and effort required to launch credit card products in new markets, replacing country-specific documentation and repeated discovery with scalable capabilities.

- Automating country readiness: Help translate regulatory requirements and market capabilities into destination architecture and configurable product behavior.

- Driving AI transformation across CC Factory: Diagnose engineering friction, establish productivity baselines, run experiments, measure impact and scale the AI practices that work.

- Building domain-grounded AI systems: Develop context engineering foundations, domain skills and repository context so AI agents can support credit card configuration and international launches with reliable outputs.

- Defining AI risk and governance: Establish appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, monitoring and auditability for AI used in regulated financial workflows.

- Leading technical architecture across multiple squads: Serve as a technical anchor across areas such as Collateral Lines, Cashback and adjacent credit card platforms, guiding architecture and unblocking complex work.

- Partnering across the organization: Align Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Compliance and platform teams around technical direction, dependencies and launch priorities.

- Staying hands-on: Prototype, code and contribute directly when needed, while adapting quickly as business priorities and market opportunities evolve.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Required

- Software engineering experience, with demonstrated Staff-level scope across multiple teams and domains.

- A track record of designing and shipping reusable platform or systemic solutions adopted by other teams.

- Current, hands-on experience with agentic AI, including coding agents, tools, skills, context engineering or RAG in production or near-production environments.

- Strong backend and distributed-systems depth, sufficient to hold architectural authority across multiple products and platforms.

- Ability to operate under deep ambiguity

title: Statistik-Berater/in (Bachelor oder Master-Abschluss) remote möglich (m/w/d)
description:

Ab 4.500 € brutto / Monat · Klare Steigerung nach Ergebnissen · Kleines Team, große Verantwortung
Worum es geht
Wir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion - von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation. Unsere Klient:innen sind keine Studenten, sondern erwachsene Profis, die liefern müssen. Du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das passiert.
Konkret heißt das: Du übernimmst Projekte von der ersten Methodendiskussion bis zur finalen Abgabe. Du analysierst Daten (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA - je nachdem, was das Projekt verlangt), überarbeitest wissenschaftliche Texte, erklärst Doktorand:innen Methoden ruhig und klar, gibst Feedback, hältst Termine ein und triffst Entscheidungen, ohne dass jemand dich an die Hand nehmen muss.
Ehrlich gesagt
Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen mit hoher Schlagzahl und hoher Effizienz. Wir brauchen sorgfältige, einsatzbereite und belastbare Leute, die methodisch sauber arbeiten, überdurchschnittlich verdienen wollen und in einem wachsenden Unternehmen von Anfang an dabei sein wollen.
Im Gegenzug bekommst du etwas, das ein Konzern nicht bieten kann: Vom ersten Tag an eigene Projekte, direkten Kundenkontakt, sichtbare Wirkung, und einen Aufstieg, der sich an deinen Ergebnissen bemisst und nicht an deiner Betriebszugehörigkeit.
Was du machst

• Mediziner:innen durch den kompletten Promotionsprozess führen - Methodik, Statistik, Schreiben, Struktur

• Statistische und qualitative Auswertungen liefern (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA)

• Doktorand:innen Methoden geduldig und klar erklären - schriftlich und im Gespräch

• Wissenschaftliche Texte überarbeiten, Feedback geben, methodische Sauberkeit sicherstellen

• Mehrere parallele Projekte koordinieren - Termine, Qualität, Kundenkontakt

• KI- und Automatisierungstools so einsetzen, dass du schneller und besser wirst als ohne

• Mit Professor:innen, Lehrstühlen und Forschungsstellen sauber kommunizieren

Was du mitbringst

• Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) in Statistik, Psychologie (empirisch/quantitativ), Sozialwissenschaft (quant), Wirtschaftsmathematik, BWL mit Empirie-Schwerpunkt, Mathematik, Public Health (quantitativ) oder vergleichbar. Eine Promotion ist nicht erforderlich und gibt hier keinen Bonus.

• Strukturierte, methodische Arbeitsweise. Du planst, bevor du loslegst. Du arbeitest sorgfältig statt hektisch. Du erkennst Inkonsistenzen in Daten oder Texten, die andere überlesen.

• Aktuelle Statistik-Praxis. Du hast in den letzten 12 Monaten konkret mit R, Python, SPSS oder MAXQDA gearbeitet - nicht nur im Studium.

• Erfahrung im Erklären von Methoden - als Tutor:in, Nachhilfelehrer:in, Übungsleiter:in, Werkstudent:in im Lehrstuhl-Umfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Wer Lernenden schon einmal Statistik ruhig erklärt hat, bringt das wichtigste Soft-Skill mit.

• Emotionale Stabilität. Wenn ein:e Klient:in panisch wird, bleibst du ruhig. Wenn drei Mandate parallel brennen, sortierst du methodisch, statt dich anstecken zu lassen. Du nimmst Fehler sachlich, nicht persönlich.

• Eigenverantwortung und Verbindlichkeit. Du strukturierst deinen Tag selbst, hältst Deadlines ein, lieferst zuverlässig - auch wenn niemand drüberguckt.

• Belastbarkeit in intensiven Phasen - keine Schönwetter-Mentalität.

• Deutsch auf C2-Niveau - du musst Texte korrigieren und gegenüber Senior-Klient:innen klar, aber respektvoll argumentieren können.

• Lust auf Privatwirtschaft, nicht auf Uni-Atmosphäre.

Berufserfahrung von Vorteil , aber kein Muss. Wir nehmen auch Berufseinsteiger:innen mit starkem Tutor-Track. Mit 2-5 Jahren Berufserfahrung in datenorientierten Bereichen (Marktforschung, Pharma-Innendienst, Junior Analytics, klinische Studien) bist du im Vorteil.
Was wir bieten

• Geld: Ab 4.500 € brutto, reale Steigerung in den ersten 6-12 Monaten nach Ergebnissen

• Aufstieg nach Leistung: Wer liefert, kommt schnell hoch - Zugehörigkeit zählt nicht

• Echte Verantwortung: Eigene Projekte, eigene Kunden, eigene Ent

ICF seeks a Disaster Recovery Training and Subject-Matter Expert to be an integral member of our multidisciplinary team in providing training, developing training materials, and contributing to product development and capacity building efforts for the U.S. Housing and Urban Development as part of the Community Compass Technical Assistance program. This position is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality learning experience s that build the capacity of recipients of Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) funds. This role specializes in developing and delivering trainings and facilitating learning engagements, combining deep subject matter expertise in disaster recovery programs with strong instructional design and facilitation skills.
We are seeking a proactive team player who will be responsible for developing training materials and products, conducting trainings (both virtual and in-person) and who can support a range of technical assistance engagements, providing direct guidance to grantees through a variety of learning environments. The person in this role will have a track record in providing training, utilizing a variety of technology platforms, conducting in-person training and requires strong knowledge of HUD disaster recovery program activities. This position may also support additional technical assistance engagements related to housing and community development, cross-cutting requirements for federal funding, and/or resilience and hazard mitigation work.
This role can be located anywhere in the continental US. Candidates located in Mountain or Pacific Time Zones or willing to work after traditional Eastern time zone work hours preferred.

How We Work - please read this part carefully
Ali, our founder and CEO, sets company priorities. You own the ideas. You will spend part of every day researching competitors, the industry and our users to generate new feature ideas, and you will keep a live Top 3 list of the highest-impact ideas for your area - a new idea only enters by beating one already on it.

Your performance is measured on two things: how often you beat your own Top 3, and the realised impact of what you ship.

title: You're Probably Not Looking. But Here You Are.

Whatever brought you here, we want to hear from you.
At Third Octet , we're a small, sharp team of people who take IT seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We work with some incredible companies across Canada, solving real technology problems that actually matter to their business. And we do it as a tight crew where every single person has fingerprints on the outcome.
There's no hiding here. No "that's not my lane." No waiting for someone above you to make a decision you could've made better yourself.
This Isn't a Role. It's a Roster Spot.
We don't know exactly what we'll need next...technical, sales, operations, or something we haven't thought of yet. But we do know the type of person we want in our corner when the time comes.
You might be a fit if:

• You do things without being asked, and you find it strange that this needs to be said

• You're the person who figures it out, not the one who waits for instructions

• You genuinely care whether the customer succeeds...not because it's in your job description, but because leaving someone stuck bothers you

• You've always got a question, a better way, or a half-baked idea that usually turns out to be a great one

• You thrive in ambiguity and treat a blank page like an opportunity, not a threat

• You want to grow fast and you're not afraid to be uncomfortable while doing it

This probably isn't for you if:

• You need a detailed playbook before you can move

• "Not my problem" is a phrase in your vocabulary

• You coast...even a little

• You're looking for a place to settle in and go quiet

Remote-first. Real flexibility. A 4.5-day work week...yes, you read that right. Benefits that are tailored to you , not a checkbox. A team that will challenge you, back you, and make you better.
But more than perks: you'll have a voice . We run Direction Checks...real, honest conversations where the team shapes where we're headed. Your opinion won't disappear into a suggestion box. It'll show up in how we operate.
And you'll grow here. Fast. Because when the team is small and the work is real, there's nowhere to hide, and nowhere to plateau.
Sound Like You?
We'd love to get to know you before we need you. Submit your resume and tell us a little about who you are. No cover letter templates. No corporate speak. Just be a human.

• Competitive salary with personally tailored benefits (health, vision, dental, paramedical).

• Flexibility in how, when, and where you work across a 4.5-day workweek with a vacation policy that is well above standards.

• Focus windows to permit deep and uninterrupted work.

• Broad exposure to technology solutions through client engagements and lab environments

• Funded lifelong learning through an immersive education platform, vendor training, and soft skills development.

• Career development paths and planning.

• Wellness support, including access to an employee wellness platform and wellness allowance.

• Open voice to shape the company's direction with leadership who serves your best interests.

• Work. Life. Balance.

We are seeking an experienced OpenShift Platform Engineer to design, deploy, and operate enterprise-grade Red Hat OpenShift container platforms running mission-critical workloads across on-premises and cloud environments. In this role you will own the end-to-end platform lifecycle - from cluster provisioning and hardening, through workload onboarding and developer enablement, to ongoing operations and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in OpenShift and Kubernetes internals, strong Linux fundamentals, and a security-first mindset, and will partner with application teams, security engineers, and infrastructure stakeholders to deliver a stable, secure, and developer-friendly container platform.
Key Responsibilities

• Architect, provision, and operate Red Hat OpenShift clusters across on-premises, virtualized, and major cloud environments, applying best practices for high availability, scalability, and security.

• Design and implement multi-tenant OpenShift platforms with appropriate project isolation, network policies, quotas, RBAC, and security context constraints.

• Automate cluster lifecycle operations - installation, upgrades, scaling, and decommissioning - using OpenShift installer, GitOps tooling (Argo CD, OpenShift GitOps), and IaC frameworks.

• Onboard application development teams to the platform, providing clear self-service patterns, project templates, CI/CD integrations, and supporting documentation.

• Operate OpenShift networking, including SDN/OVN-Kubernetes, ingress controllers, routes, network policies, and integration with enterprise firewalls and load balancers.

• Manage OpenShift storage strategies (block, file, object), including dynamic provisioning, OpenShift Data Foundation, and integration with external storage platforms.

• Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing using the OpenShift observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, EFK, Tempo) and integrate with enterprise SIEM and APM tools.

• Harden the platform in collaboration with security teams, including image scanning (Quay/Clair), runtime protection, secret management, and continuous compliance with regulatory frameworks.

• Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines on OpenShift using Tekton, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Argo Workflows, enabling safe and frequent application deployments.

• Develop disaster-recovery and backup strategies for cluster state, etcd, and persistent workloads, validated through regular failover and restore drills.

• Plan, test, and execute cluster upgrades across minor and major versions with minimal disruption to workloads, including pre-upgrade validation and rollback strategies.

• Partner with application teams to right-size workloads, manage resource quotas, and tune cluster autoscaling for predictable performance and cost efficiency.

• Continuously evolve platform tooling and developer experience, capturing feedback from internal users and translating it into roadmap improvements.

• Mentor junior engineers and act as an OpenShift subject-matter expert across the broader organization.
